{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# Note: revenue is stored as string with thousands separators
# Example: '1,234.56' → 1234.56

# Remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter: only completed orders and exclude internal test orders
# Internal test orders have revenue == 999999.99
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed, non-test orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
